title: The spare key still on the ring
body: One key on the ring is dusted gray; another has a clean thumb mark on its bow. The clipboard remains upright between them, closed around the empty impression of a removed sheet.
rival_reading: A field team could move its notes and leave access keys behind during a test or shutdown; the missing sheet does not prove response officials failed.
gloss: A keyring remains with an empty clipboard impression, as if a handoff stopped mid-task.

title: The weather note ends at the low ground
body: The notebook’s rain sketch runs into a drawing of crop rows. A capped water bottle stands beside it, its pale sediment ring on the outside rather than inside.
rival_reading: A station crew could record rain and water conditions while planning evacuation routes; the drawing and residue do not show that an agricultural program caused the danger.
gloss: A weather sketch and field rows share a notebook beside a bottle marked by dried sediment.
